If we expect the hashrate to drop significantly before the merge is that something that should be considered?
Each halving of the hashrate will make the bomb feel "accelerated" by 100k blocks so if hashrate drops 90% bomb will be felt 1.5 month early, and this can happen suddenly if the hashrate drops suddenly

excerpts.author: timbeiko
excerpts.content: Yes, that’s a very good point!
